title: Senior Video Editor & AI Video Creator
description:
**About the Role**

We’re looking for a Video Editor & AI Video Creator who can turn raw footage, or just an idea, into scroll-stopping content. This is not a role for someone who simply cuts clips together. We want someone who understands hooks, pacing, retention and storytelling, and who is excited about AI video.

**What You’ll Work On**

* Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts for brands, founders and personal brands
* Event aftermovies and highlight reels (marathons, conferences, galas, concerts)
* AI-generated videos for campaigns where there is no shoot
* Ads for Meta and YouTube
* Brand films and founder content

**What You’ll Do**

* Edit 15–25 short-form videos a month, each with a strong hook in the first 2 seconds
* Create AI videos and visuals (text-to-video, image-to-video, AI avatars, AI voiceovers)
* Add motion graphics, animated captions, transitions, sound design and colour grading
* Adapt one video into every format: 9:16, 1:1 and 16:9
* Work closely with designers, strategists and account managers to meet deadlines
* Keep project files clean and organised

**What We’re Looking For**

* 2+ years of professional video editing experience (agency experience preferred)
* Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects (mandatory)
* Hands-on AI video experience with tools like Runway, Kling, Veo, Higgsfield, Hailuo, HeyGen or similar
* AI image and audio tools like Midjourney, Firefly, Nano Banana, ElevenLabs or similar
* Strong understanding of Instagram and YouTube trends, trending audio and retention
* Ability to handle multiple clients and deadlines without dropping quality

**Good to Have**

* 2D animation or motion design
* Basic Photoshop, Illustrator or Canva
* Event or phone shooting basics
* CapCut for quick trend edits

**Why Join Digi Kydo**

* Your showreel will feature names like Round Table, YPO and ICAI
* Huge variety: events, celebrities, jewellery, wellness, non-profits and clubs
* Freedom to experiment with the latest AI tools on real client work
* Clear growth path to Senior Editor and Creative Lead
* Work from our Kolkata office with a full creative team

Pay: ₹17,000.00 - ₹27,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
